notes: Restocks are watched closely: for 3 minutes after a tracker's alert or an in-stock reading, the buying browser looks at the listing itself every 4 seconds (the other buying browsers every 10) and checks out the moment it can be bought at or under your cap. Until now it was told of the same listing at most once in 15 seconds, and only after a reader had seen it come back. The checkout itself, your caps and one order per product are unchanged. The diagnostics now list what every close watch saw. Failure messages no longer say 'MANUAL RE-ARM REQUIRED' next to 'it is tried again at once'.
